row:
I'm Caroline Williams, CRM L5 Dip, ACMT a Clinical Reflexologist & Massage Therapist, providing video tips for sports massage and clinical reflexology

I hold a Level 5 Mastership from the Reflexology Academy in London, the highest qualification in the field of reflexology. I was lucky enough to study for two years with world-leading reflexologist Hagar Basis. As a clinical reflexologist I am trained to work with clients with specific medical conditions. I’m also trained in baby reflexology and massage as well as foot reading.

I have completed training in Advanced Clinical and Sports Massage (ACMT) with Jing Advanced Clinical Massage Training, and I’m currently in the second year of a BTEC Level 6 Diploma in Advanced Clinical Massage and Sports Massage with Jing Advanced Clinical Massage Training. The highest level of massage training in the UK.
